summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError (direct Exception subclass) and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), which follows the spec's seven-step procedure using read-only graph lookups. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture, parametrized valid and invalid cases covering every error branch, plus tests that the graph is unchanged and that rdf:nil raises. Running pytest on the new test module and test/test_path.py with the shared venv gives 42 passed. The test file changed on disk after I wrote it; I reran against the current version and did not revert it. No formatter or linter was run because none appeared to be installed in the venv. Nothing was committed and no packages were installed.
